cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says the country is live on PAPSS: a regional payment system, or joining PAPSS, does not count.
cells.note: The Bank of Mozambique supervises the national switch and launched the Metix instant payment system in March 2026. No regional link has been found. Mozambique joined PAPSS in September 2026 (MOZ-008), with banks invited to onboard, but no live participation has been found, and accession alone is not counted.
